description: The grouped bar chart illustrates the negative log probability of per-specialty terms across different fine-tuning conditions. The horizontal category axis, labeled "Per-specialty terms," displays six categories arranged alphabetically: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics. The vertical value axis is labeled "Negative log probability" and features a linear scale ranging from -22 at the top to -27 at the bottom, with tick marks at intervals of 1 unit. The bars originate from the -22 baseline and extend downwards to represent the negative values. Within each of the six per-specialty term categories, there is a group of seven bars. The first bar in each group is light blue, corresponding to a top legend entry with obscured text. The subsequent six bars in each group represent models "Fine-tuned on:" specific specialties, indicated by a color gradient legend: Cardio (very light orange), Gastro (light orange), Infect (medium-light orange), Neuro (medium orange), Obstetrics (dark orange), and Pediatrics (dark brown). The light blue bars consistently extend the furthest downwards in every group, with the longest reaching approximately -26.8 in the Cardio terms category. The orange and brown fine-tuned bars are shorter, indicating values closer to the -22 baseline. The shortest bars overall are found in the Infect terms category, where the fine-tuned bars cluster around -23.0 to -23.2. Across all groups, the fine-tuned bars exhibit similar lengths within their respective clusters, such as ranging from approximately -25.7 to -26.1 for Cardio terms and -23.5 to -24.0 for Pediatrics terms. Within each group, the bars follow a consistent order starting with the light blue bar followed by the fine-tuned specialties from Cardio to Pediatrics, with no additional visual emphasis applied to individual bars.
